# masamune_core

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Library that provides the core part of the Masamune framework. It provides Path map, data management, task management and utility.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune_core
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/masamune_core
